tax_sec_56_2_xii_reit_repayment.label: REIT/InvIT Debt Repayment Taxation Section
tax_sec_56_2_xii_reit_repayment.effective_period: Tax year 2026–27; Income-tax Act, 2025 as amended by Finance Act, 2026
tax_sec_56_2_xii_reit_repayment.assumptions: Taxable specified sum is max(A − B − C, 0): A is cumulative qualifying distributions to current/prior holders; B is unit issue price, not secondary purchase cost; C is sums already taxed under this clause. _decision_model.scope: Educational review for individuals in the displayed 20s–50s age brackets. Self-selected ordinary-income marginal rates; not a tax-return calculator or full financial plan.

Includes 4% health and education cess, assumes no surcharge, rebate, relief, deductions, exemptions or band crossing. It is not a total-income tax calculation, effective tax rate, capital-gains calculation or forecast.
